title: Data Scientist
description: Designs statistical models, develops predictive machine learning pipelines, extracts actionable business insights, and validates data hypotheses.
preparationAdvice: Focus heavily on statistical inference, bias-variance tradeoff, ROC-AUC metrics, and the math behind gradient descent.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds and deploys scalable artificial intelligence systems, deep neural networks, computer vision models, and large language model integrations.
preparationAdvice: Master neural network architectures, attention mechanisms, loss functions (cross-entropy vs. MSE), and model deployment via Docker and FastAPI.

title: Data Analyst
description: Translates complex numerical data into clear visual dashboards, performs exploratory data analysis, and assists executive decision-making.
preparationAdvice: Practice advanced SQL joins, group by, analytical window functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER), and data visualization best practices.

title: Python Developer
description: Engineers robust backend services, automated data processing scripts, algorithmic components, and clean object-oriented architectures.
preparationAdvice: Sharpen your knowledge of Pythonic conventions (PEP 8), magic methods (`__init__`, `__repr__`), exception handling, and core algorithmic data structures.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Develops highly scalable server-side systems, RESTful microservices, caching layers, and database schemas with high reliability.
preparationAdvice: Study the Node.js event loop lifecycle, middleware chaining, SQL transaction ACID properties, and API security (CORS, CSRF, XSS prevention).

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description: Constructs end-to-end web applications bridging modern responsive client interfaces with secure, scalable backend services.
preparationAdvice: Be prepared to demonstrate how client state connects to backend REST endpoints, handles loading/error states, and manages component re-rendering.
